Name: Aethelstan Dog Replacer
Author: Kuradjinou
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45624/45624-1777563052-2138621166.png[/img]
Replaces the (first) dog in Stardew Valley with Lord Aethelstan. If you don't know who Lord Aethelstan is, he's a chill and silly guy who [url=https://www.twitch.tv/lordaethelstan]streams on Twitch[/url] and also [url=https://www.youtube.com/@lordaethelstan69/releases]creates music[/url]. Aside from chatting and messing around, he mostly plays action games and rogue-likes.

If you like this mod, you may also like my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8674]Nyanners Cat Replacer mod[/url].

[b][size=4]﻿INSTALLATION:[/size][/b]
[spoiler]    -Download and install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] if you haven't already.
    (It will also require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI﻿[/url])

    -Download the mod.

    -Unzip the AethelstanDogReplacer zip file.

    -Place the unzipped folder ( [CP] AethelstanDogReplacer) into the Mods folder (e.g. C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods)

    -Start the game using SMAPI (StardewModdingAPI.exe in the Stardew Valley folder).

    -Play the game![/spoiler]



Last functionality test was on Stardew Valley v1.6.15.
If you have any troubles with the mod, leave a comment and I'll try to get back to you when I can.
-Kuradjinou
